spectral.true_color: High confidence: water is very dark blue-green, vegetation is muted green to olive-brown, and narrow shoreline surfaces are pale gray-green. Land interiors are mottled, while most water is relatively smooth. No extensive bright sediment plume is visible; high confidence.
spectral.false_color: High confidence: most land interiors become moderately strong red to crimson, while open water becomes nearly black or dark navy. Pale cyan-gray margins and internal patches interrupt the red vegetation signal. Red response is extensive across the northern, northwestern and southeastern landmasses.

implications.claim: Most land supports vegetation with appreciable near-infrared reflectance.
Vegetation appears broadly active, but the display does not establish quantitative vigor or absence of stress.
Dark connected surfaces are open water, consistent with low near-infrared reflectance.
There is no obvious widespread highly turbid water, although dark color alone cannot establish clarity or suspended sediment concentration.
Pale shoreline patches may represent exposed rock, sparse vegetation, shallow water or mixtures of these.
Bare soil and built materials cannot be reliably separated from exposed rock using these renderings.
Vegetation and soil moisture differences cannot be diagnosed reliably from these displayed bands alone.

spectral.not_revealed: High confidence: these rendered composites do not provide calibrated reflectance, quantitative vegetation indices, water depth, salinity, water quality, vegetation species, canopy height, soil moisture or temporal change. They cannot establish hydrological connectivity beyond the crop or distinguish seasonal from persistent conditions.

interpretation.claim: The scene is predominantly a natural or seminatural vegetated island waterscape.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 1–3; all cells: irregular land outlines, continuous water and numerous vegetated islands, with no evident organized parcel pattern.

interpretation.claim: Woody vegetation is plausible on the larger landmasses, but forest, scrub and mixed low vegetation cannot be separated confidently.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 2 and 4; top_center, top_right and bottom_right: mottled interiors with extensive red near-infrared response.

interpretation.claim: There is no positive evidence of cultivated fields, crop rotation, irrigation or recent harvest.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 2–3; all land-containing cells: no regular parcels, row structure or irrigation geometry is resolved. Crop identity and management remain undetermined.

interpretation.claim: Settlement, roads and active forestry management are not demonstrated.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 2–3; all cells: no convincing building clusters, linear road network or geometric clearing pattern is visible.

interpretation.claim: Vegetation cover is widespread, with localized less-vegetated surfaces; ecological health cannot be quantified.
interpretation.evidence: Level 4; top_left, top_center, top_right and bottom_right: extensive red interiors interrupted by pale patches.

interpretation.claim: Rocky shoreline exposure is plausible, but active erosion, flooding or recent clearing is not established.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 3–4; middle_center, middle_right, bottom_left and bottom_right: pale irregular margins without a clear sediment plume or diagnostic disturbance pattern.

interpretation.claim: A temperate or boreal rocky island setting is plausible, but biome and climate attribution is weak.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 1–4; larger northern and southeastern landmasses: vegetated mottled interiors, irregular pale shores and abundant water. These characteristics are not climate-specific.

interpretation.claim: Coastal archipelago and island-rich lake interpretations both remain viable.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 1–3; all cells: the crop contains islands and connected water but no diagnostic tidal, salinity or basin-scale context.

summaries.w25: High confidence: dark water surrounds irregular vegetated islands. Medium confidence: pale shores are partly rocky. Season, management and coastal versus inland setting remain unresolved.
summaries.w50: High confidence: this is an island-rich waterscape with irregular vegetated landmasses and connected channels. Medium-confidence cover estimates are 58% water, 35% vegetation and 7% exposed or sparse surfaces. Red false-color interiors indicate vegetation. Pale shores may be rocky. Season, biome, water quality and management remain unresolved.
summaries.w100: High confidence: interconnected dark water surrounds irregular vegetated islands and edge-clipped landmasses. Medium-confidence estimates assign 58% to water, 35% to vegetation and 7% to exposed or sparsely vegetated surfaces. High confidence: vegetation appears extensively red in false color, with pale shoreline fringes and internal patches. Northern channels open into broader central and southern water. summaries.w200:
High confidence: the patch depicts an island-rich waterscape with irregular vegetated landmasses, narrow channels and broader central and southern water. Medium-confidence area estimates are 58% open water, 35% vegetation and 7% exposed or sparsely vegetated surfaces.

High confidence: a large northern landmass extends southward, a fragmented island complex occupies the northwest, and broad land enters from the southeast. Smaller islands punctuate the middle, while an elongated island lies near the southwestern margin. Pale fringes outline many shores.

High confidence: land interiors are muted green-brown in true color and extensively red in false color, supporting substantial vegetation cover. Medium confidence: some cover is woody and some pale surfaces are exposed rock. Shoreline shallows and mixed pixels are alternative explanations for the fringes.

High confidence: no organized agricultural pattern is evident. Medium confidence: roads, settlement and forestry management are not demonstrated. High confidence: vegetation stress, moisture, water depth, salinity and active erosion cannot be established. A temperate or boreal setting is plausible with low confidence. Coastal archipelago and island-rich lake interpretations remain unresolved.
summaries.w400:
High confidence: this 1.2 km square patch is an island-rich waterscape dominated by connected dark water and irregular vegetated land. Medium-confidence visual estimates are 58% water, 35% vegetation and 7% exposed or sparsely vegetated surfaces; these fractions are approximate.

High confidence: the northern half is relatively land-rich. Its largest landmass continues beyond the upper edge and tapers southward between water passages. A lobed island complex occupies the northwest. An elongated island lies near the center, a compact island lies farther east, and broad vegetated land enters from the southeastern edge. Southwestern edge-connected land and a separate east–west island border the lower water area. The bottom-center cell is almost entirely open water. Medium-confidence measurements place the visible northern landmass at approximately 450 × 580 m and the central island at approximately 180 × 230 m.

High confidence: water is dark blue-green in true color and nearly black in false color. Land interiors are mottled green-brown in true color and predominantly red to crimson in false color, demonstrating substantial vegetation with appreciable near-infrared reflectance. Medium confidence: larger interiors contain woody cover, while pale shoreline fringes and internal patches include exposed or sparsely vegetated substrate. Rock, shallow water and mixed pixels cannot be separated consistently. No extensive bright sediment plume is evident, but water clarity is not established.

High confidence: no regular cultivated parcels or irrigation geometry is visible. Medium confidence: settlement, roads and active forestry management are not demonstrated. Vegetation appears broadly active with medium confidence, but species, canopy structure and ecological health remain unresolved. A temperate or boreal rocky setting is plausible with low confidence; the imagery provides insufficient evidence for a firm biome or climate assignment.

High confidence: coastal archipelago and island-rich lake interpretations both remain viable. The renderings cannot quantify moisture, turbidity, water depth or salinity, establish a specific season, or diagnose recent erosion, flooding, harvest or clearing. Native 10 m resolution limits small-feature identification, and display stretching and shoreline mixing complicate spectral interpretation.
